global: A bowl of vibrant, spicy tom yum ramen broth glows warmly, topped with fresh cilantro and bean sprouts. The white ceramic bowl sits on a wooden table, softly lit to highlight the rich, red-orange broth and the spoon resting beside it.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, showing natural wood surface details.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, slightly glossy surface, subtle brownish rim stain, and rounded, thick edge.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, shrimp, bean sprouts, and cilantro, glossy surface with visible spices and herbs.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
